rationale: C23 is an especially strong reusable drafting template: its two operative sentences are nearly verbatim counterparts of the child's first two sentences, with only the named organization and pronouns changed. The child then adds a corporation-specific limitation concerning its Articles of Agreement. C02 and C06 belong to the same highly specific designation template family, but C23 is the closest in wording, structure, and date.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hereby designate the International Finance Corporation as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hereby designate the World Meteorological Organization as a public international organization entitled to enjoy the privileges, exemptions, and immunities conferred by the said International Organizations Immunities Act.
shared_material.explanation: The operative designation formula is identical apart from the organization name.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The designation of the International Finance Corporation made by this order is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such corporation may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or Congressional action
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The designation of the World Meteorological Organization as a public international organization within the meaning of the said International Organizations Immunities Act is not intended to abridge in any respect privileges, exemptions, and immunities which such organization may have acquired or may acquire by treaty or congressional action.
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same distinctive non-abridgment safeguard, with minor adaptation for the corporation and a shortened introductory phrase.
